cases.name: Helen Kent Marple Cardwell
cases.about: She was scheduled to start work as a technician the following day at Lutheran General Hospital in Park Ridge. her obituary said she was employed as a chemical technician for Cooper Biomedical and later as a lab technician for North American Paint. She earned a degree in Zoology from Marshall University in 1979. She was participating in a rehabilitation program in Niles following a massive stroke in 1991.
cases.narrative: Her sister found her on her bed nude except for a pair of socks, with a sweater around her neck, in her room at the Niles YMCA..
